node.title: Micro-lemma: pin the pair-ledger exponent (min(s,t) vs min(s,t-1))
node.statement: For two size-(k+t) supports at exchange distance s, the exact pair codimension is t+min(s,t). Thus q^(-min(s,t)) is the conditional second-event cost, while min(s,t-1) is the anchored/projective convention. This is an exponent dictionary, not a proof of averaged slope de-correlation.
node.attack_surface: recompute the toy pair-ledger at both exponents vs the exact counts
node.falsifier: the toy ledger matching neither exponent
node.notes: PROVED exact linear algebra: codim=t+min(s,t). Evidence-only for averaged_xr after canonical false-green correction 3cca68b7.
